sequence_column.title: Sequence column
sequence_column.description: Column containing BCR nucleotide sequences (gapped or ungapped).

clone_id_column.title: Clone ID column
clone_id_column.description: Column used to group sequences into clones.

germline_id_column.title: Germline/allele column
germline_id_column.description: Column storing V germline IDs or alleles that BrepPhylo will map to its germline database.

label_column.title: Label column
label_column.description: Optional human-readable label for tips; falls back to sequence order if empty.

which_clones.title: Restrict to clone IDs
which_clones.description: Optional list of clone IDs to include, as a comma/space/semicolon-separated string (e.g. 'c1, c2 c3'). Empty means all clones. Mutually exclusive with ignore_clones.

ignore_clones.title: Ignore clone IDs
ignore_clones.description: Optional list of clone IDs to exclude, as a comma/space/semicolon-separated string. Mutually exclusive with which_clones.

input_sequence_mode.title: Input sequence mode
input_sequence_mode.description: raw_sequence: sequences are not assumed IMGT-gapped; BrepPhylo may run MSA. aligned_imgt_gapped: sequences are already IMGT-gapped/aligned; alignment algorithm is not used.

tree_type.title: Tree inference method
tree_type.description: Tree construction method passed to treeConstruction$type ('simple', 'dnapars', or 'igphyml').

collapse_and_replace.title: Collapse identical sequences (dnapars)
collapse_and_replace.description: If true, collapse identical sequences before parsimony reconstruction and re-expand afterwards (tree_type = 'dnapars').

igphyml_accuracy.title: IgPhyML accuracy preset
igphyml_accuracy.description: Accuracy preset passed to IgPhyML (basic, high, or extreme); only used when tree_type = 'igphyml'.

make_alignment_pdf.title: Write alignment PDF
make_alignment_pdf.description: Generate alignment PDF per clone (makeAlignmentPDFConstruction). Requires LaTeX in the runtime environment.

min_clone_size.title: Minimum clone size
min_clone_size.description: Discard clones with fewer sequences than this threshold before tree building.

species.title: Species
species.description: Species identifier for selecting BrepPhylo germline references. Use 'custom' to supply a germline FASTA via the textarea below.

germline_set_text.title: Custom germline set
germline_set_text.description: Copy file content of IMGT-format germline V-gene FASTA. Required when species = 'custom'.

algorithm.title: Alignment algorithm
algorithm.description: Multiple sequence aligner; only used when input_sequence_mode = 'raw_sequence'.

gather_plots.title: Gather plots
gather_plots.description: Gather individual clone plots into a combined PDF where supported.

enable_csr_analysis.title: Enable CSR / isotype analysis
enable_csr_analysis.description: Run class-switch recombination and arborescence analysis after tree inference.

isotype_column.title: Isotype/subclass column
isotype_column.description: Column containing isotype or subclass labels for CSR analysis. Required when enable_csr_analysis = true.
